newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai May budget deficit at 78.8 million baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai May budget deficit at 78.8 million baht.

text.p: Thailand recorded a budget deficit in May of 78.8 million baht, bringing the total deficit so far for fiscal 1996/97 (October-September) to 50.47 billion baht, a finance ministry official said on Monday.
The cash balance deficit was recorded at 4.7 billion baht ($190 million) against the surplus of 7.6 billion baht in April, the official said.
The cash balance, which is the government's current account, includes non-budgetary revenue and expenditure such as remittances from state enterprises.
The non-budgetary deficit was 4.62 billion baht.
The official did not provide the reason for the substantial deficit for non-budgetary items.
However, the October-May non-budgetary balance still recorded a suplus of 928 million baht.
The total revenue since October, when the fiscal year started, was 520.27 billion baht while spending totalled 570.74 billion baht, the official said.
